item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the incorporation jurisdiction and IRS EIN, then I’ll return the shortest document-supported answer in the required one-line format.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -i "state of incorporation|jurisdiction of incorporation|employer identification number|IRS Employer Identification Number|I.R.S. Employer Identification Number|Employer Identification Number|incorporation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2021_10K_reconstructed.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -i "state of incorporation|jurisdiction of incorporation|employer identification number|IRS Employer Identification Number|I.R.S. Employer Identification Number|Employer Identification Number|incorporation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2021_10K_reconstructed.json'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2021_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=[re.compile(r'state of incorporation|jurisdiction of incorporation|employer identification number|i\\.?r\\.?s\\.? employer identification number|incorporation',re.I)]
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    s=t.get('text','')
    if any(p.search(s) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'LABEL',t.get('label'))
        print(s[:2000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2021_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:

texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=[re.compile(r'state of incorporation|jurisdiction of incorporation|employer identification number|i\\.?r\\.?s\\.? employer identification number|incorporation',re.I)]
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    s=t.get('text','')
    if any(p.search(s) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'LABEL',t.get('label'))
        print(s[:2000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"

Employer Identification Number|Employer Identification Number|incorporation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2021_10K_reconstructed.json | head -n 80'
